summary: Three Lions Acquisition Corp., a Cayman blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting completion of its $100.0 million IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, alongside a $4.0 million private placement of 400,000 units at $10.00 to Three Lions Sponsor, LLC, EarlyBirdCapital and third-party investors. As of September 2, 2026, $100.5 million was deposited in trust. Underwriter EarlyBirdCapital holds a 45-day option for up to 1,500,000 over-allotment units. Watch redemptions, deal-sourcing timeline and the 18-month completion clock.
